long_biography.plain_text:
The 2017 division of Marvipol separated two businesses that Mariusz Wojciech Książek had developed within one listed group. Property projects moved into Marvipol Development, while automotive distribution continued independently. As founder, main shareholder and president, Książek retained responsibility for the real-estate company and sharpened its focus on housing and warehouse development.

Marvipol had begun by providing services to other developers before undertaking projects for its own account. Książek later brought Jaguar and Land Rover distribution into the group and guided its Warsaw listing. The eventual separation converted that diversification into distinct corporate platforms, leaving Marvipol Development as his principal operating and ownership base.
